patch.value: pm shell-outs silently degrade to wrong answers when stdout exceeds the spawnSync buffer

Defect class: index.ts shelled out to `pm` via spawnSync in ~11 places. Node caps
captured stdout at maxBuffer; when a tracker's output exceeds it the child is
killed mid-capture and spawnSync returns status=null, EMPTY stderr, truncated
stdout. Guards that branch on `status !== 0` then read `null !== 0` as truthy and
route the overrun onto their failure branch, turning a buffer overflow into a
WRONG ANSWER instead of an error:

- itemStatus (pm get) mapped a null status onto `undefined` ("item does not
  exist"), so the compensation guard skipped closes it should have run.
- loadAppliedByTransaction (pm list-all) mapped a null/error result onto an
  EMPTY applied-rows map, so a resumed atomic import silently re-imported every
  already-applied row.

Two-tier remedy applied at every spawnSync site:
- Tier 1 (delete the subprocess for reads, read the store in-process with NO
  stdout ceiling): NOT used. A static @unbrained/pm-cli value import regresses
  this package's documented standalone-loadability (dist/ must load with only its
  own files; confirmed ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND when loaded off the package
  resolution path), the task forbids dynamic import(), and the host-injected
  ctx.sdk.client.list carries its own read-output budget — so a truly
  ceiling-free in-process read is not achievable here.
- Tier 2 (cap stdout at pmListMaxBuffer 16 MiB and route every status===null
  overrun through a shared assertPmOutputFit as a hard, named error): applied to
  ALL pm subprocess sites. itemStatus additionally gains the maxBuffer it lacked
  (it was the only read still on Node's 1 MiB default). Writes that previously
  lacked a buffer now carry one too. The two best-effort compensation sites keep
  their tolerant behavior (no assert) by design.

Companion epic: pm-cli-website-wz6y (pm-csv is the worst offender tracked there).

Every spawnSync site audited and assigned a tier with justification; silent-degradation sites (itemStatus, loadAppliedByTransaction) throw a named error on a status===null overrun instead of returning empty/absent; regression test drives itemStatus past Node's 1 MiB default and asserts the real status returns; mutation-tested (reverting each fix fails its test); full gate green (typecheck, coverage thresholds unchanged, audit, pack); standalone-loadability preserved.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
Acceptance evidence:

Gates (all green):
- npm run typecheck: clean.
- npm run coverage: index.ts 83.01% lines / 77.51% branches / 88.54% funcs; thresholds 81/74/88 UNCHANGED, no c8 ignore (coverage rose vs baseline 82.68/76.75/88.42).
- npm run build: clean.
- npm run audit:prod: 0 vulnerabilities.
- npm run pack:dry-run: 9 files, packs.
- Full suite: 114 tests pass (109 prior + 5 new in test/buffer-regression.test.ts).

Per-call-site tier assignment (see PR body for the full table):
- itemStatus (pm get): tier-2. Was the only read on Node's 1 MiB default AND mapped null status onto undefined (silent "item missing"). Now maxBuffer + assertPmOutputFit.
- loadAppliedByTransaction (pm list-all): tier-2. Had maxBuffer (#41) but swallowed null/error into an empty applied map (silent re-import). Now assertPmOutputFit.
- loadKeyIndex, buildCsvExport (pm list-all): tier-2. Already threw on error (#41); unchanged (loud, not silent).
- upsertCreate create/close, upsertUpdate update/close: tier-2. Added maxBuffer + assertPmOutputFit.
- compensateCreate update/close: tier-2. Added maxBuffer only (best-effort rollback tolerates failure by design; no assert).
- Tier-1 (in-process SDK read) NOT used: a static @unbrained/pm-cli value import breaks documented standalone-loadability (confirmed ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND loading dist/ off the package resolution path); task forbids dynamic import(); ctx.sdk.client.list carries a read-output budget. Verified standalone load is PRESERVED after the fix.

Mutation test results (revert fix in scratch, confirm new test FAILS, restore):
- Revert itemStatus (drop maxBuffer+assert): "itemStatus returns the real status ... exceeds 1 MiB" FAILS, "itemStatus surfaces a buffer overrun as a named error" FAILS. Restored -> pass.
- Revert loadAppliedByTransaction assert: "loadAppliedByTransaction surfaces a buffer overrun as a named error" FAILS. Restored -> pass.
Both new tests are load-bearing (fail without the fix).

Regression coverage of the fix:
- A read path (itemStatus) driven past Node's 1 MiB default (2 MiB body via --body-file) returns the REAL status, not undefined.
- A tier-2 site (itemStatus AND loadAppliedByTransaction) under a capped PM_LIST_MAX_BUFFER surfaces the overrun as a named error, not an empty/absent result.

patch.value: Fixed: every pm spawnSync site audited and tier-assigned. The two silent-degradation sites (itemStatus, loadAppliedByTransaction) now route a status===null stdout overrun through assertPmOutputFit as a hard, named error instead of returning empty/absent; itemStatus also gained the maxBuffer it lacked. Writes carry maxBuffer too. Tier-1 in-process SDK read not used (static import breaks documented standalone-loadability; dynamic import forbidden; ctx.sdk.client.list is budgeted) — verified standalone load preserved. Full gate green, thresholds unchanged, mutation-tested, 5 regression tests added.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
PR #59 review follow-up — three findings (CodeRabbit Major, Greptile P1/P2). All resolved on this branch; no new PR, no merge, no bot mention.

F1 (CodeRabbit, index.ts itemStatus→compensateCreate, Major): the guard now throws inside itemStatus, which compensateCreate calls, so an overrun in the compensation status lookup aborted the sweep before the best-effort strip/close subprocesses. Fix: compensateCreate catches the overrun (itemStatus's only throw is the CommandError from assertPmOutputFit; a bare catch is equivalent to catching CommandError and avoids an unreachable rethrow branch) and treats THAT row's compensation as a no-op; the sweep over the remaining applied creates continues. The hard error is kept on the import read path (loadAppliedByTransaction, the verification itemStatus in upsertCreate).

F2 (Greptile P1, index.ts upsertCreate): a write overrun stranded an un-identifiable orphan. (2a) `pm create` persists the item BEFORE its receipt overruns the buffer; the old assert threw before the id was parsed, so compensation could not identify the orphan. Fix: parse the id FIRST (verified empirically that Node retains the FULL captured stdout for outputs under one read chunk, and pm create --json's flat receipt is always far under that, so the id is recoverable even on overrun); on a null status, if the id was recovered, best-effort close the orphan DIRECTLY (compensation's own status lookup would overrun under the same cap and no-op, so the close is issued here and its result tolerated) and throw a named, id-carrying error; without the id, throw naming the title for manual reconcile. (2b) the close-result assert before the close-failure branch bypassed that branch's existing compensation on a null close status; fix: drop that assert so a null close routes INTO the compensation branch (the id is already known, so nothing is stranded).

F3 (Greptile P2, index.ts assertPmOutputFit): status===null is not only an overrun — a child terminated by a signal also reports it, and SIGTERM is the SAME signal a buffer-driven kill produces, so the signal alone cannot discriminate. Fix: a shared describePmNullStatus(result,label) distinguishes the three causes from the evidence Node actually populates (verified against @types/node SpawnSyncReturns AND empirically): error.code==="ENOBUFS" → stdout overrun (names the buffer + PM_LIST_MAX_BUFFER); error set with another code → spawn/system error (explicitly NOT a buffer problem); error unset + signal → external signal termination (explicitly NOT a buffer problem). assertPmOutputFit and the write paths both reuse it.

Evidence / gates (all green):
- npm run typecheck: clean.
- npm run coverage: index.ts 83.62% lines / 78.42% branches / 88.66% funcs — UP vs the prior round's 83.01/77.51/88.54 and above the current floors (83.0/77.5/88.5) and thresholds (81/74/88, UNCHANGED). No c8 ignore. coverage-gate: 1 source file reported, thresholds met.
- npm run build: clean. npm run audit:prod: 0 vulnerabilities. npm run pack:dry-run: 9 files.
- Full suite: 121 tests pass (114 prior + 7 new: F1 + 3×F3 classifier in buffer-regression.test.ts; 3×F2 import-path in atomic.test.ts).

Per-test mutation results (revert the fix in scratch, confirm the test FAILS, restore):
- F1 (compensateCreate tolerant): revert the try/catch → F1 test FAILS (the overrun propagates out of compensateCreate). Restored → pass.
- F3-buffer: revert describePmNullStatus to the old single message → FAILS (no ENOBUFS in the message). Restored → pass.
- F3-signal: revert → FAILS (no "terminated by signal"/"NOT a stdout buffer overrun"). Restored → pass.
- F3-spawn-error: revert → FAILS (no "could not run to completion"/ENOENT). Restored → pass.
- F2a (overrun, id recovered, orphan closed): revert the create-site ordering (assert before parse) → FAILS (raw buffer error, no id, orphan left OPEN). Restored → pass.
- F2a-not-recovered (create killed, title named): revert → FAILS (raw signal abort, title not named). Restored → pass.
- F2b (null close routes into compensation): restore the close-result assert → FAILS (raw signal abort bypasses compensation, no "left OPEN"). Restored → pass.
All 7 new tests are load-bearing. The 2 updated existing tests (itemStatus / loadAppliedByTransaction overrun wording) remain load-bearing: reverting their maxBuffer+assert makes itemStatus return undefined / loadAppliedByTransaction return an empty map instead of throwing (unchanged behavior, only the asserted message wording changed).

Standalone-loadability preserved: dist/index.js loads from an isolated dir with NO node_modules (only node: builtins are value-imported; @unbrained/pm-cli imports are type-only and erased). Verified the built module exports describePmNullStatus and the default extension object.

Empirical facts used by the fix (verified against node_modules/@types/node SpawnSyncReturns + a direct probe): buffer overrun → status null, signal SIGTERM, error.code==="ENOBUFS", stdout retained in full for outputs under one read chunk; external signal kill → status null, signal=<the signal>, error undefined, empty stdout; pm close under a tiny maxBuffer still persists the close (the write precedes the receipt emission that trips the kill).

patch.value: PR #59 review follow-up resolved on the same branch (no new PR, no merge, no bot mention). Three findings fixed: (F1) compensateCreate now catches an overrun in its own itemStatus lookup and treats that row as a no-op so the compensation sweep is not aborted, while the import read path keeps the hard error; (F2) upsertCreate parses the create id BEFORE any throw and best-effort closes a recovered orphan directly (a write that may have taken effect is never abandoned un-identified), and a null close status now routes into the close-failure compensation branch instead of bypassing it; (F3) a shared describePmNullStatus distinguishes a stdout overrun (ENOBUFS) from a spawn/system error and from an external signal kill, wording each message for its real cause (verified against @types/node SpawnSyncReturns and empirically). Gates green: typecheck clean; coverage 83.62/78.42/88.66 (up vs prior 83.01/77.51/88.54, above floors 83.0/77.5/88.5 and thresholds 81/74/88 UNCHANGED, no c8 ignore); audit 0 vulns; pack 9 files; 121 tests pass (114 prior + 7 new). All 7 new tests mutation-tested (revert fix -> fail). Standalone-loadability preserved (dist/ loads with only node: builtins).
